purpose: Measure bounded live or supplied presentation properties against the AXM accessibility floor and flag violations without restyling or claiming a full audit.
procedure: Read bounded supplied measurements or request them from an injected exact-target computed-style adapter.
Reuse Visual Kernel contrast math and apply the declared floor: 4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text and UI components, 44px targets, critical text at least 10px, and a visible equal for sound signals.
Attach the measured number to every PASS, FAIL, or UNKNOWN rule result.
Return UNKNOWN for missing or invalid property groups; partial input is never a silent PASS.
Seal typed measurements, release the supplied set, and take no direct action.
rules: UNKNOWN is preferred to a plausible guess.
Every use emits a typed receipt and releases raw material.
boundaries: Does not restyle, repair, or auto-adjust a surface.
Does not read text content, content meaning, or judge taste.
Does not claim WCAG certification or a full accessibility audit.
Does not retain raw pixels or the supplied property set.
A missing per-use adapter, incomplete element coverage, gradients, background images, transparency, or ancestor opacity remain explicit UNKNOWN results.

retention.law: EPHEMERAL BY DEFAULT. Raw sense material is released at the next step. Only a bounded typed receipt survives.
retention.released_when: before the typed observation is returned
retention.accumulation_across_uses: flat and zero after every release boundary
retention.deletion_scope: only material created by the exact sense use, by exact id or path; never a wildcard or recursive sweep
